title: SpaceXAI Video 1.5 Lite Beats Google Veo 3.1 in Performance Benchmarks

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The latest AI video tool from Elon Musk's SpaceXAI has reached the #17 spot on the AA-Video-T2V v2.0 leaderboard, placing it two positions above Google's Veo 3.1. At 1080p resolution, Video 1.5 Lite costs $0.14 per second, which is approximately 35% of the $0.40 per second price of Google's competing model. The tool generates clips ranging from 1 to 15 seconds and is currently available through the SpaceXAI API, Vercel AI Gateway, and fal.

Artificial Analysis benchmarks show no other model on the AA-Video-T2V-Silent v2.0 list is both faster and higher quality, with Video 1.5 Lite producing 10 second 1080p clips in a median of 60.5 seconds. This Lite version is 44% cheaper than the original Grok Imagine Video 1.5, which costs $0.25 per second at 1080p, though it ranks six places lower. While it excels in lighting and text rendering, it trails competitors in human anatomy and lip sync.

selectedTweets.text:
Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite lands at #17 on both AA-Video-T2V v2.0 leaderboards and takes a position on the Pareto frontier for quality and speed

Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite is the new lower-cost model in SpaceXAI's Grok Imagine video family. It generates Text to Video clips of 1 to 15 seconds at 480p, 720p or 1080p, and also supports Image to Video.

In the Artificial Analysis Video Arena, Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite ranks #17 on both AA-Video-T2V v2.0 and AA-Video-T2V-Silent v2.0, ahead of Google's Veo 3.1 at about a third of its price. It comes closest to the frontier in Multi-Scene & Narrative, Lighting & Materials and Text Rendering, and in the Architecture & Real Estate and Consumer use cases.

In our end-to-end generation time benchmarks, it is the fastest model at its level of quality, at a median of 60.5 seconds for a 10 second 1080p clip, which places it on the quality and speed Pareto frontier.

SpaceXAI prices Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite at $0.14 per second of 1080p video ($8.40 per minute), the resolution we evaluated. That is 56% of the $0.25 per second that Grok Imagine Video 1.5 costs at 1080p. Lite drops to $0.03 per second at 720p and $0.02 per second at 480p.

Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite is available via the SpaceXAI API, on fal at the same prices, and on Vercel AI Gateway.

Congratulations to @SpaceXAI & @elonmusk on the release!

See below for our detailed analysis and comparisons between Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite and other leading models in the Artificial Analysis Video Arena 🧵

selectedTweets.text:
Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite sits on the quality and speed frontier on AA-Video-T2V-Silent v2.0

Among the 12 models on AA-Video-T2V-Silent v2.0 that we benchmark for generation speed, no model is both faster and higher quality than Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite. It generates a 10 second 1080p clip in a median of 60.5 seconds. Kling 3.0 1080p (Pro) scores slightly higher and takes 94 seconds for a 5 second clip. Vidu Q3 Turbo is 9 seconds faster on a 5 second 720p clip, and scores well below it.
